16pub fn bytes_to_string(encoding: &CodedCharacterSet, bytes: &[u8], out: &mut String) -> Result<()> {
17    for b in bytes {
18        let Some(g) = encoding.get(*b as usize).copied().flatten() else {
19            continue;
20        };
21
22        for ch in char::decode_utf16([g.utf16_code_unit()]).flatten() {
23            out.push(ch);
24        }
25    }
26
27    Ok(())
28}
29
30pub fn string_to_bytes(encoding: &CodedCharacterSet, text: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
31    let mut out = Vec::new();
32    write_to_bytes(encoding, text, &mut out);
33    out
34}
35
36pub fn write_to_bytes(encoding: &CodedCharacterSet, text: &str, out: &mut Vec<u8>) {
37    for c in text.encode_utf16() {
38        let g = Glyph::from_utf16_code_unit(c);
39
40        let Some(n) = encoding.iter().position(|glyph| glyph.is_some_and(|f| f == g)) else {
41            continue;
42        };
43
44        out.push(n as u8);
45    }
46}

48pub enum Encoding<'a> {
49    OneByteEncoding(&'a CodedCharacterSet),
50    SimpleEncoding(&'a [u8]),
51    UnicodeMapEncoding(ToUnicodeCMap),
52    Differences(Differences<'a>),
53}
54
55impl std::fmt::Debug for Encoding<'_> {
56    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
57        match self {
58            // UnicodeCMap and Bytes encoding ommitted to not bloat debug log
59            Self::OneByteEncoding(_arg0) => f.debug_tuple("OneByteEncoding").finish(),
60            Self::SimpleEncoding(arg0) => f.debug_tuple("SimpleEncoding").field(arg0).finish(),
61            Self::UnicodeMapEncoding(_arg0) => f.debug_tuple("UnicodeMapEncoding").finish(),
62            Self::Differences(_arg0) => f.debug_tuple("Differences").finish(),
63        }
64    }
65}

67impl Encoding<'_> {
68    pub fn bytes_to_string(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {
69        let mut out = String::new();
70        self.write_to_string(bytes, &mut out)?;
71        Ok(out)
72    }
73
74    pub fn write_to_string(&self, bytes: &[u8], out: &mut String) -> Result<()> {
75        match self {
76            Self::OneByteEncoding(map) => {
77                bytes_to_string(map, bytes, out)?;
78                Ok(())
79            }
80            Self::SimpleEncoding(b"UniGB-UCS2-H") | Self::SimpleEncoding(b"UniGB-UTF16-H") => {
81                out.push_str(UTF_16BE.decode(bytes).0.as_ref());
82                Ok(())
83            }
84            Self::UnicodeMapEncoding(unicode_map) => {
85                let mut output_bytes = Vec::new();
86
87                // source codes can have a variadic length from 1 to 4 bytes
88                let mut bytes_in_considered_code = 0u8;
89                let mut considered_source_code = 0u32;
90                for byte in bytes {
91                    if bytes_in_considered_code == 4 {
92                        let mut value = unicode_map.get_or_replacement_char(considered_source_code, 4);
93                        considered_source_code = 0;
94                        bytes_in_considered_code = 0;
95                        output_bytes.append(&mut value);
96                    }
97                    bytes_in_considered_code += 1;
98                    considered_source_code = considered_source_code * 256 + *byte as u32;
99                    if let Some(mut value) = unicode_map.get(considered_source_code, bytes_in_considered_code) {
100                        considered_source_code = 0;
101                        bytes_in_considered_code = 0;
102                        output_bytes.append(&mut value);
103                    }
104                }
105                if bytes_in_considered_code > 0 {
106                    let mut value = unicode_map.get_or_replacement_char(considered_source_code, bytes_in_considered_code);
107                    output_bytes.append(&mut value);
108                }
109                let utf16_str: Vec<u8> = output_bytes.iter().flat_map(|it| [(it / 256) as u8, (it % 256) as u8]).collect();
110
111                out.push_str(UTF_16BE.decode(&utf16_str).0.as_ref());
112                Ok(())
113            }
114            Self::SimpleEncoding(b"WinAnsiEncoding") => {
115                bytes_to_string(&WIN_ANSI_ENCODING, bytes, out)?;
116                Ok(())
117            }
118            Self::SimpleEncoding(_) => Err(Error::CharacterEncoding),
119            Self::Differences(differences) => differences.bytes_to_string(bytes, out),
120        }
121    }
122
123    pub fn string_to_bytes(&self, text: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
124        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
125        self.write_to_bytes(text, &mut bytes);
126        bytes
127    }
128
129    pub fn write_to_bytes(&self, text: &str, out: &mut Vec<u8>) {
130        match self {
131            Self::OneByteEncoding(map) => write_to_bytes(map, text, out),
132            Self::SimpleEncoding(b"UniGB-UCS2-H") | Self::SimpleEncoding(b"UniGB-UTF16-H") => encode_utf16_be(text, out),
133            Self::SimpleEncoding(b"WinAnsiEncoding") => write_to_bytes(&WIN_ANSI_ENCODING, text, out),
134            Self::UnicodeMapEncoding(unicode_map) => {
135                let mut i = 0;
136                while i < text.chars().count() {
137                    let current_unicode_seq: Vec<u16> = substr(text, i, 1).encode_utf16().collect();
138
139                    if let Some(entries) = unicode_map.get_source_codes_for_unicode(&current_unicode_seq) {
140                        if let Some(entry) = entries.first() {
141                            // TODO: Add logic to pick the best entry if multiple
142                            let mut bytes_for_code = Vec::new();
143                            let val = entry.source_code;
144                            match entry.code_len {
145                                1 => bytes_for_code.push(val as u8),
146                                2 => bytes_for_code.extend_from_slice(&(val as u16).to_be_bytes()),
147                                3 => {
148                                    bytes_for_code.push((val >> 16) as u8);
149                                    bytes_for_code.push((val >> 8) as u8);
150                                    bytes_for_code.push(val as u8);
151                                }
152                                4 => bytes_for_code.extend_from_slice(&val.to_be_bytes()),
153                                _ => { /* Should not happen */ }
154                            }
155                            out.extend(bytes_for_code);
156                        } else {
157                            // No specific entry, handle as unmappable
158                            log::warn!("Unicode sequence {current_unicode_seq:04X?} found in map but no entries, skipping.");
159                        }
160                    } else {
161                        // Character or sequence not found in CMap
162                        log::warn!("Unicode sequence {current_unicode_seq:04X?} not found in ToUnicode CMap, skipping.");
163                    }
164                    i += 1;
165                }
166            }
167            Self::SimpleEncoding(_) => {
168                debug!("Unknown encoding used to encode text {self:?}");
169                out.extend_from_slice(text.as_bytes());
170            }
171            Self::Differences(differences) => {
172                differences.string_to_bytes(text, out);
173            }
174        }
175    }
176}

178/// Encodes the given `str` to UTF-16BE.
179/// The recommended way to encode text strings, as it supports all of
180/// unicode and all major PDF readers support it.
181pub fn encode_utf16_be(text: &str, out: &mut Vec<u8>) {
182    // Prepend BOM to the mark string as UTF-16BE encoded.
183    let bom_be: [u8; 2] = [0xFE, 0xFF];
184    out.extend_from_slice(&bom_be);
185    out.extend(text.encode_utf16().flat_map(|b| b.to_be_bytes()));
186}
187
188/// Encodes the given `str` to UTF-8. This method of encoding text strings
189/// is first specified in PDF2.0 and reader support is still lacking
190/// (notably, Adobe Acrobat Reader doesn't support it at the time of writing).
191/// Thus, using it is **NOT RECOMMENDED**.
192pub fn encode_utf8(text: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
193    // Prepend BOM to the mark string as UTF-8 encoded.
194    let mut bytes = vec![0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF];
195    bytes.extend(text.bytes());
196    bytes
197}

204    #[cfg(any())]
205    fn unicode_with_2byte_code_does_not_convert_single_bytes() {
206        let mut cmap = ToUnicodeCMap::new();
207
208        cmap.put(0x0000, 0x0002, 2, cmap::BfRangeTarget::UTF16CodePoint { offset: 0 });
209        cmap.put(0x0024, 0x0025, 2, cmap::BfRangeTarget::UTF16CodePoint { offset: 0 });
210
211        let bytes: [u8; 2] = [0x00, 0x24];
212
213        let result = Encoding::UnicodeMapEncoding(cmap).bytes_to_string(&bytes);
214
215        assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), "\u{0024}");
216    }
217
218    #[cfg(any())]
219    fn winansi_bytes_to_string() {
220        // 0xe9 = é in WinAnsi, 0xfc = ü, 0xdf = ß
221        let bytes = [0x41, 0xe9, 0x42, 0xfc, 0xdf]; // AéBüß
222        let result = Encoding::SimpleEncoding(b"WinAnsiEncoding").bytes_to_string(&bytes).expect("WinAnsi decode should succeed");
223        assert_eq!(result, "AéBüß");
224    }
225
226    #[cfg(any())]
227    fn winansi_string_to_bytes() {
228        let text = "Sébastien 0,019€ ü ÄÖÜ ß";
229        let bytes = Encoding::SimpleEncoding(b"WinAnsiEncoding").string_to_bytes(text);
230        // Round-trip: decode the bytes back via the same encoding
231        let decoded = Encoding::OneByteEncoding(&WIN_ANSI_ENCODING).bytes_to_string(&bytes).expect("WinAnsi decode should succeed");
232        assert_eq!(decoded, text);
233    }
